notes.title: Demo Rework and Update
notes.notes:
Major Rework of the Demo/Intro

 New Start Area/Tutorial
 Changes to Start of the game
 Weaknesses/Resistances for enemies
 Boss Intros
 Sewer reworked some to now take into account the weakness/resistances 
 Sewer now dark
 Torches added for in and out of combat
 The Farm is no longer accessible in the Demo
 New Character menu to view inventory - Press C to view
 Various Bug Fixes


I will be working on some more changes to the Demo/Intro here soon and another update will come in March. This will add more cutscenes/story elements to the game.

Thank you for playing the demo and wishlisting the game!

-Kurock
